actionCalls.description: Standard Initiate Renewal action for one end-date group. The first call creates the quote, linked to the primary opportunity (and the shared contract, if any); later calls add their assets to it through renewRecordId.
actionCalls.name: Renew_Group
actionCalls.label: Renew Group

assignments.description: Counts the distinct assets the lines reference and the assets the running user could read, to catch a partial lookup.
assignments.name: Count_Line_Assets
assignments.label: Count Line Assets

assignments.description: The extra assets may not belong to the opportunities' contract, and Initiate Renewal rejects any asset outside the contract it is given, so no contract is passed.
assignments.name: Add_Account_Assets
assignments.label: Add Account Assets

assignments.description: Bundle components renew with their bundle, so only the root asset is passed to Initiate Renewal.
assignments.name: Add_Root_Asset_Id
assignments.label: Add Root Asset Id

decisions.description: Same rule as the action's visibility on the record page: only an open renewal opportunity (Type Existing Business) can absorb other renewals.
decisions.name: Is_Open_Renewal
decisions.label: Is Open Renewal

decisions.description: Only root assets are renewed, and only those no open renewal opportunity or its quote already covers.
decisions.name: Is_Covered_Asset
decisions.label: Is Covered Asset

decisions.description: Initiate Renewal requires every asset to belong to the contract it is given, so the contract is passed only when all the opportunities share it.
decisions.name: Is_Same_Contract
decisions.label: Is Same Contract

decisions.description: Keeps LineAssetIds distinct, so its count can be compared with the assets read.
decisions.name: Is_New_Line_Asset
decisions.label: Is New Line Asset

decisions.description: The asset lookup runs as the user, so assets they can't read are silently left out. Consolidating only the readable subset would drop products from the renewal, so stop instead.
decisions.name: Are_All_Assets_Readable
decisions.label: Are All Assets Readable

decisions.description: Initiate Renewal with explicit dates reads the renewal term from the asset itself, even when a contract is passed, so an asset without one would fail the whole quote.
decisions.name: Is_Renewable_Asset
decisions.label: Is Renewable Asset

decisions.description: Groups assets by end date. Initiate Renewal applies one start date to every asset in a call, so each group is renewed by its own call.
decisions.name: Is_Same_Group
decisions.label: Is Same Group

decisions.description: After a group is renewed mid-loop, the current asset starts the next group.
decisions.name: Is_Last_Group
decisions.label: Is Last Group

Flow.description: Quick action on a renewal Opportunity. Merges other open renewal opportunities on the same account (same price book and currency) into this one, optionally with the account's renewable assets that no open renewal covers: renews the root assets of all their lines (and those assets) onto one quote linked to this opportunity, cotermed to an end date the user picks (default one year after the latest asset ends), then closes the others as Closed Lost. Initiate Renewal takes one start date per call, so it is called once per asset end date, the first call creating the quote and later ones adding to it through renewRecordId. Ramped assets can't be cotermed.

formulas.description: One year after the latest asset ends.
formulas.name: DefaultTargetEndDate

formulas.description: Midnight GMT on the day after the group ends, the same value Initiate Renewal gets from a date-only start.
formulas.name: GroupStartDateTime

Flow.label: RLM Consolidate Renewal Opportunities

recordLookups.name: Get_Other_Renewals
recordLookups.label: Get Other Renewals

recordLookups.description: Every open renewal on the account, whatever its price book: their assets are already being renewed, so they are not offered as extra assets.
recordLookups.name: Get_Open_Renewals
recordLookups.label: Get Open Renewals

recordLookups.name: Get_Open_Renewal_Quotes
recordLookups.label: Get Open Renewal Quotes

recordLookups.description: Active lifecycle-managed assets on the account in the opportunity's currency that haven't ended.
recordLookups.name: Get_Account_Assets
recordLookups.label: Get Account Assets

recordLookups.description: Sorted by end date, so assets that end together are next to each other and the last one ends latest.
recordLookups.name: Get_Root_Assets
recordLookups.label: Get Root Assets

fields.name: SelectionErrorText
fields.fieldText: Select at least one opportunity or include the other assets.

fields.name: SelectRenewalsText
fields.fieldText: Choose what to merge into {!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name}. Everything is renewed on one quote linked to this opportunity, and the selected opportunities are closed as Closed Lost.

fields.name: Include_Account_Assets
fields.fieldText: Also renew the {!ExtraAssetCount} other renewable assets on this account that no open renewal opportunity covers

fields.name: ConfirmText
fields.fieldText:
Renew {!RootAssetCount} assets on one quote for {!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name}?

Each asset renews from the day after it ends to the end date below, so the renewal is cotermed. The latest asset ends on {!LatestEndDate}. Then {!ClosingCount} selected opportunities are closed as Closed Lost.

validationRule.errorMessage: Choose a date after {!LatestEndDate}, when the latest asset ends.

fields.name: Not_Open_RenewalText
fields.fieldText:
{!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name} isn't an open renewal opportunity, so nothing was consolidated.

This action works on open opportunities with Type Existing Business.

fields.name: No_Other_RenewalsText
fields.fieldText: There is nothing to consolidate into {!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name}: no other open renewal opportunities on this account share its price book and currency, and every renewable asset on the account is already on an open renewal.

fields.name: No_Renewable_AssetsText
fields.fieldText: Nothing selected is linked to an asset, so there is nothing to renew.

fields.name: Assets_Not_ReadableText
fields.fieldText:
You don't have access to {!MissingAssetCount} of the {!LineAssetCount} assets on the selected opportunities, so nothing was consolidated. A quote made without them would leave those products out of the renewal.

Ask your admin for access to the account's assets, then try again.

fields.name: Unrenewable_AssetsText
fields.fieldText:
These assets have no end date or no renewal term and unit, so they can't be cotermed: {!UnrenewableAssetNames}

Set Renewal Term and Renewal Term Unit on them (for example in the Managed Asset viewer), then try again.

fields.name: Consolidation_ErrorText
fields.fieldText:
The renewals were not consolidated.

{!$Flow.FaultMessage}

If a renewal quote was already started it is linked to this opportunity; delete it before trying again.

fields.name: Close_ErrorText
fields.fieldText:
The renewal quote was created, but the other opportunities were not closed.

{!$Flow.FaultMessage}

Close them as Closed Lost by hand.
